title: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
title_zh: CausalAlign：面向一致自运动的视频生成模型因果对齐

paragraphs.en: CausalAlign通过将视频生成模型表征与3D基础模型对齐，显著提升相机自运动一致性和具身任务成功率。 Diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) can produce visually plausible videos, yet their camera ego-motion often drifts over long horizons. Camera ego-motion determines how the viewpoint changes between frames and is essential for maintaining consistent geometry and trajectories. To address this problem, we propose CausalAlign, a causal alignment framework with two components. First, we diagnose how precise ego motion is represented, used, and retained within VGMs using linear probes and causal interventions, revealing a rise-and-fall pattern during denoising. Second, we strengthen ego-motion state in VGM by aligning the representations at the identified layers to a 3D foundation model through delta-token space. This space encodes the changes between consecutive frames, allowing the alignment to focus on ego-motion dynamics rather than static scene content. With Wan2.2 fine-tuned on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, CausalAlign can largely improve motion accuracy, geometric consistency, and temporal smoothness, while preserving visual quality. For example, it improves geometric consistency by more than 20% relative to the base model. Moreover, with the fine-tuned VGM, CausalAlign improves the success rate of world action models (WAMs) by 10 points on mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365 benchmark. Overall, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based VGMs and yields noticeable gains in embodied models.
paragraphs.zh: CausalAlign通过将视频生成模型表征与3D基础模型对齐，显著提升相机自运动一致性和具身任务成功率。基于扩散的视频生成模型（VGM）能够生成视觉上可信的视频，但其相机自运动在长时间跨度上往往会发生漂移。 相机自运动决定了视角在帧与帧之间的变化方式，对于维持一致的几何结构和轨迹至关重要。 为解决这一问题，我们提出了CausalAlign，一个包含两个组件的因果对齐框架。 首先，我们利用线性探针和因果干预诊断精确自运动在VGM内部是如何被表示、使用和保留的，揭示了一种在去噪过程中先升后降的模式。 其次，我们通过在识别出的层上将表征经增量token空间对齐到3D基础模型，来强化VGM中的自运动状态。 该空间编码相邻帧之间的变化，使对齐能够专注于自运动动态而非静态场景内容。 通过在DL3DV和RealEstate10K上对Wan2.2进行微调，CausalAlign能够在保持视觉质量的同时，大幅提升运动精度、几何一致性和时间平滑性。 例如，相对于基础模型，它将几何一致性提升了20%以上。 此外，借助微调后的VGM，CausalAlign在RoboCasa365基准的移动操作任务上将世界动作模型（WAM）的成功率提升了10个百分点。 总体而言，CausalAlign提升了基于扩散的VGM中的自运动一致性，并在具身模型中带来了显著收益。
